newsitem.title: USA: Merck backs Q1 EPS view of $0.80-$0.87/shr.
newsitem.headline: Merck backs Q1 EPS view of $0.80-$0.87/shr.

text.p: Merck & Co Inc chairman and chief executive Raymond Gilmartin said the company is comfortable with Wall Street analysts' first quarter earnings estimates in the $0.80 to $0.87 per share range.
"We're comfortable with the range that's out there," Gilmartin told Reuters in an interview following remarks made to the Executives' Club of Chicago.
Merck earned $0.70 per share in the year-ago quarter.
He said Merck continues to expand production of Crixivan, an AIDS-combatting protease inhibitor that is in such heavy demand that the company had trouble making enough last year.
He said New Jersey-based Merck filed in December with the U.S. Food and Drug Administration for permission to market Propecia, a new treatment for male pattern hair loss.
Shares in Merck were off 3-1/2 to 93-7/8 as U.S. drugmaker stocks fell broadly for the second straight day.
